Images of real people are supported: URL and Base64 inputs are automatically registered as assets before

reference_videos.description: Reference video URLs or asset references for multimodal reference, video editing, or extension. Up to 10 videos. duration.description: Video duration in seconds (4-30), or -1 for the model to choose automatically. Video-EDITING prompts (operating on an input video) accept only -1: the output tracks the input video's length (may be ~0.4s shorter).

resolution.description: Video resolution. 480p, 720p, and 1080p are native Seedance outputs. return_last_frame.description: Whether to return the last frame as a separate image.

reference_audios.description: Reference audio URLs, Base64, or asset references. Formats: wav/mp3, duration [2,30]s per clip, max 15MB each.
